messages:
emily: quick UX thread we need to finalize where the token breakdown accordion lives when switching scope (org vs project). current mock has it under the chart and it pushes the invoice CTA down which looks odd on mobile. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/usage-billing-v2 rob: agree on mobile pain. proposal A: keep breakdown inline below chart for desktop, but move it to a separate tab on mobile so invoice CTA stays visible. priya: accessibility concern: if we move to a tab, ensure the tabs are tabbable and have proper ARIA: role=\"tablist\" + role=\"tab\" + aria-selected. screen reader should announce when the panel changes. keith: from engineering POV, tabs are fine. but tabs add context switching which might confuse users who expect to see tokens next to charts. is there data on how often users toggle between token view and chart view? emily: analytics show ~18% of org-level sessions open the breakdown after viewing charts. project-level is 35%. so project is higher. sana: copy nit: the accordion header currently says \"Token breakdown (est.)\". change to \"Token breakdown — estimated\" for clarity and avoid parentheses. designbot: uploaded two variants: https://assets.redwood/screencap/breakdown-inline.png and breakdown-tab.png. inline variant has a subtle divider; tab variant hides breakdown under a \"Details\" tab. rob: layout nit for desktop: when the org scope is active, the invoice CTA should be in the top-right of the panel (sticky) so users can download before they scroll into breakdowns. priya: accessibility for sticky CTA: ensure it doesn't overlap content when zoomed (200%). also ensure it has an accessible name like \"Download invoice\" and keyboard focus style. keith: technical: making CTA sticky inside the panel is simple, but mobile safari sometimes causes repaint jank. we could instead duplicate the CTA (one sticky, one inline) but that complicates analytics. prefer single CTA with position: sticky and fallback. emily: duplication might be okay if we add data attributes to suppress double events. but i prefer single sticky if stable. qa-bot: reminder: invoice downloads need correct content-disposition header and include line items for the selected scope. previously we had a bug where org downloads showed project-only lines. filing ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/INV-402 priya: concerning keyboard navigation inside the token accordion: when it expands, focus should move to the first interactive element inside (copy CSV button). or should it keep focus on the header? thoughts? rob: i vote move focus to first actionable item. otherwise keyboard users have to tab through the header again. but we must announce expansion via aria-live. sana: recommended pattern: keep header focus, but set aria-expanded=\"true\" and put an instruction link as the first focusable element inside panel with text \"Jump to token CSV\". that way user chooses to go in. avoids surprising focus shifts. keith: we implement as sana suggests. also adding small inline code for the accordion markup so devs are aligned: ```
Jump to token CSV
``` priya: love the sr-only focusable link. make sure its text is visible to SRs and keyboard users but visually hidden otherwise. use the standard SR CSS utility. emily: ux decision on scope label placement: when org scope is selected we currently place a small breadcrumb above charts. some reviewers said it looks like a filter pill. i'd prefer explicit label: \"Viewing: Organization — Acme Corp\" and for projects \"Viewing: Project — Search UI\". rob: that explicit text helps with voiceover context. also include the date range in the same live-region when toggles change so users aren't disoriented. sana: live-region suggestion: have a single aria-live=\"polite\" region that composes messages like: \"Viewing Organization Acme Corp. Date range: Mar 1 Mar 31. Token breakdown available.\" Keep it brief. designbot: added small UI tweak to reduce visual weight of the breadcrumb and increase contrast on the CTA: https://assets.redwood/screencap/billing-cta-contrast.png keith: CSS tokens i'll change: --cta-bg to #0a66ff (passes 4.5:1 on white), --breadcrumb-text to #6b7280. will include in PR. emily: question on CSV: should CSV include both aggregated month totals and per-day rows depending on the current rollup toggle? i'd expect it to match what's shown. rob: yes, CSV should mirror UI. add metadata column \"rollup_mode\" with value \"daily\" or \"monthly\" so downstream tools know how to interpret. also include header comment row? maybe avoid comments in CSV. priya: accessibility for CSV download link: use role=\"button\" and aria-describedby targeting region that explains file format briefly: \"CSV includes timestamp, token_type, tokens, cost_estimate.\" qa-bot: QA note: test CSV with large org (100k rows) to ensure streaming response and memory safety. ticket filed: https://jira.redwood/browse/CSV-78 emily: ok action items recap: emily -> decide inline vs tabs for mobile by EOD Wed (prefers tab), rob -> implement sticky CTA fallback and analytics tag, keith -> CSS token updates + implement sr-only jump link, priya -> ARIA docs + tablist pattern, sana -> run a11y audit and signoff, designbot -> push updated comps. QA-bot -> run perf test for CSV. rob: will target a small feature flag `breakdown_mobile_tab_v1` to roll out. keith: will have PR ready in 2 days, will add unit tests for aria attributes. emily: thanks all. adding short note to product spec: \"CSV mirrors UI rollup mode; token accordion remains accessible via sr jump link; invoice CTA sticky on desktop, tab on mobile behind feature flag.\" ping me for wording tweaks. :sparkles:
